title: Theme-aware public site
summary: The fivepixels site now supports persistent light and dark themes through a single adaptive token system.

paragraphs: Visitors can switch themes from the global header. The selected theme is stored locally and applied before hydration to avoid a flash of the wrong color scheme.

sections.heading: What changed
items: Adaptive surface, text, border, and status tokens drive the public content pages.
The theme preference persists between visits.
System preference is used when no explicit choice has been saved.

title: Pretendard is now the only typeface
summary: All public UI and code examples now use the locally hosted Pretendard font family.

paragraphs: The font stack has been reduced to the five locally hosted Pretendard weights used by the interface. This removes third-party font requests and keeps typography consistent.

title: Public content is now English-only
summary: The language switcher and Korean copy have been removed from the fivepixels public experience.

paragraphs: Navigation, product explanations, guides, documentation, and examples now share one English source of truth.

title: Updated adoption and developer guides
summary: The guide collection has been rebuilt around the current fivepixels workflow and API surface.

sections.heading: A clearer path from trial to rollout
paragraphs: The new guide separates reviewer workflow, team rules, DOM tagging, and developer setup so teams can adopt one useful path at a time.

title: Improved marker restoration after layout changes
summary: Marker lookup now handles common component movement without dropping the original review context.

paragraphs: Restoration now gives stable report identifiers priority and uses nearby DOM structure as a fallback when the original node is no longer in the same position.
